meta.seo_description: Download Incoterms 2020 rules for international trade. Get 11 essential terms, including risk and cost allocation. Free in Excel, CSV, PDF.
meta.title: Incoterms 2020 Rules & Definitions Dataset
meta.description: This dataset provides a concise list of the 11 Incoterms 2020 rules, detailing responsibilities for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation in international trade. It covers all key aspects for buyers and sellers.
key_takeaways: Access the 11 Incoterms 2020 rules for global trade.
Explore definitions, transport modes, and risk transfer points.
Understand seller and buyer cost responsibilities.
use_cases: Import the **CSV** file into your ERP or logistics system to automate contract clause generation and compliance checks for international shipments.
Use the **Excel** file to filter terms by transport mode, analyze cost allocation, and prepare training materials for your sales or procurement teams.
Print the **PDF** version for a quick, offline reference guide in warehouses, classrooms, or during contract negotiations.
Leverage this data for educational purposes to teach students about global supply chain management and trade regulations.
